widgets_values:
A glossy black sports car is parked completely still on a vast dry lake bed.

The car remains completely stationary throughout the entire shot.
The wheels do not rotate and the vehicle does not move.

The camera moves slowly and smoothly straight forward toward the rear of the car.
The camera does not orbit around the vehicle and does not move sideways.

The car remains centered and geometrically stable.
Its body shape, taillights, wheels and proportions remain unchanged.

The mountains, horizon and dry lake surface remain spatially stable.
Natural perspective and subtle parallax only.

No lateral camera movement.
No orbit.
No rotation around the car.
No scene morphing.
No geometry distortion.
No background sliding.

Bright midday sunlight with realistic shadows.

Audio: no dialogue, no human voice, no music.
Only gentle desert wind and a quiet engine idle.

BSAI SolarWM-H3 Generate / 一键生成
================================
[Camera / 相机参数]
orbit_turns: 环绕圈数 (负=反向) / Orbit turns
radius: 起始距离 / Start distance
radius_end: 结束距离 (推拉) / End distance
height: 相机高度 / Camera height
height_end: 结束高度 (升降) / End height
start_angle: 起始角度 (0=前 0.25=侧) / Start angle
pan_speed: 水平摇摄 / Pan speed
tilt_speed: 俯仰弧度 / Tilt speed
look_at_y: 注视点高度 / Look-at Y
================================
[Sampling / 采样]
seed: 随机种子 / Random seed
steps: 去噪步数 (蒸馏用4) / Denoise steps
sampler_name: 采样器 / Sampler
scheduler: 调度器 / Scheduler
鼠标滚轮可调节数值

widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-8s] Cinematic, photorealistic. A rugged coastline at golden hour. Large ocean waves roll in from the horizon, cresting and crashing against dark rock formations. White foam explodes on impact and rushes up the shore. The camera is positioned at a medium-wide angle, slightly elevated. Sea spray catches the warm backlight, creating a misty glow. The horizon glows orange-pink. Seagulls wheel in the distance. The rhythm of the waves is hypnotic — each wave slightly different in size and shape. Wet rocks glisten with reflected light. The camera holds steady, letting the natural power of the ocean be the focus. Long exposure effect on the water creates smooth, silky textures in the receding surf.

overall_soundscape: Rhythmic ocean waves crashing and retreating, sea spray, distant seagulls, and coastal wind.

non_diegetic_music: A gentle ambient track with soft piano notes and oceanic synth textures, peaceful and meditative.
